properties.warning_message: Thunderstorm with Lightning is likely to occur at isolated places over Bagalakote, Belagavi, Bidar, Chikkamagaluru, Dakshina Kannada, Davanagere, Dharwad, Gadag, Hassan, Haveri, Kalaburagi, Koppal, Shivamogga, Vijayapura and Yadgir districts during next 3 hours. Source: IMD Bangalore.
